body: Important distinction: the CAA warning establishes that recovery-scam cases exist; it does not by itself tell us whether they are accelerating. Para matawag na trend, gusto ko ng comparable consultation counts over time, repeated warnings, or multiple independent datasets. The psychological mechanism can be real even when the frequency trend is unknown. Translation: protect yourself now, but huwag gumawa ng epidemic graph gamit ang isang press release at malaking marker pen.

claims.text: The cited warning supports the existence and practical relevance of recovery scams but does not establish that their incidence is increasing over time.
claims.basis: Trend inference: the article provides a current official warning and general psychological research, but no longitudinal incidence series.
